name: OS Client Certs -- decrypt & re-encrypt S/MIME forward
description: When forwarding an S/MIME encrypted message, automatically decrypt the original, replace the raw smime.p7m blob with the decrypted content and attachments, and re-enable S/MIME encryption for the new recipients. Requires identity with S/MIME signing/encryption certificates. v0.2.7 (TEST): privileged ForwardIntercept Experiment patches the mail window's ComposeMessage to redirect a forward directly to a reply at compose-open time — clearing recipients and retitling Re: -> Fwd: immediately (no visible window flicker of the original recipients).
